config._about: v2 checks. Every geometric v1 review issue has a row here; the id in each 'why' points into ../renders/attempt-N/review.md (A1-#n, A2-#n, A3-Xn). Object names follow DESIGN_LOG.md 'v2 naming'. distances.a/b are exact names. Attempt 2: rows tagged v2-A1-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-1/review.md. PIV_hood values in rows: +1.315 = gap 5.3 (printed min-gap stop, HOOD_HI), -0.558 = gap 7.0 (thumbwheel stop-sleeve static max); keep them in sync with params.solve_eps if NIP_SET changes. Attempt 3: rows tagged v2-A2-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-2/review.md. NEW PIV_hood values: +0.327 = gap 6.2 (HOOD_GAP_MIN raised 5.3 -> 6.2 for A2-01, printed min-gap stop, HOOD_HI), -0.558 = gap 7.0 (static max, unchanged); PIV_nip_lift -1.493 = the leaf stack goes solid against the cover roof (LEAF_PAD_H + LEAF_T = 4.5 between thumbwheel and roof). Nip rays are framed in PIV_hood (A2-04: the PIV_tilt-framed y37 ray slipped past the hood lip at full lift).
